summary: One-frame event written by esv::TagSystem::ProcessStatusTagNotificationRequest (EoCServer.dll+0xB66290): for each entity with queued esv::TagSystem::StatusTagNotificationRequest (32-byte elements: data + bool at +0x1C) it pushes an esv::tags::StatusTagNotificationData (32 bytes, name from the IndexedStorage assert in EoCServer.dll+0xB53DB0) into one of two arrays, chosen by that bool. The data matches esv::StoryGameEventManager::ThrowStatusTagSet/Cleared(entity, entity, Guid tag, StoryActionID). Seen alive on status/tag changes (dialogs, spells, statuses).

fields.name: Cause
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xB64C30 ProcessBoostChangedEvents writes request +0 = *FUN_1803ad100(world, boost owner/source entity) (a component holding an entity, default DAT_1821ea008); matches the second EntityHandle of ThrowStatusTagSet(ls::ID const&, ls::ID const&, Guid const&, StoryActionID). Live samples hold entity handles.

fields.name: Tag
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xB64C30 copies 16 bytes from the tag Guid returned by FUN_180b563c0 to +8; FUN_180b53db0 copies param_3 (16 bytes) to element +8

fields.name: StoryActionId
fields.evidence: FUN_180b53db0 copies a 4-byte value to element +0x18; ThrowStatusTagSet takes TypeWrap<unsigned int, eoc::TStoryActionIDClassname> as last argument; the value comes from +0x10 of a component in ProcessBoostChangedEvents

fields.name: _Pad1C
fields.evidence: in the request this byte is the bool selecting the array; FUN_180b53db0 does not copy it into the event element

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xB66290: element stride 0x20; target is the component itself when request byte +0x1C == 0. Request byte +0x1C = (BoostChangedEvent.field_4 == 0) in EoCServer.dll+0xB64C30 line 319. Live: pointer + small cap/size. Which of Set/Cleared this is is not established.

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xB66290: target is component+0x10 when request byte +0x1C != 0. Live: pointer in 44 of 48 samples, sizes 1-2.

open_questions: Which array holds set and which cleared tags (depends on meaning of BoostChangedEvent.field_4)
Exact meaning of the first entity (cause vs status entity)
